items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: It gave me an opportunity to meet the players.

ctx.x: Well, then, you got a call from Hamp.

Yeah. I got this call to join Hamp's band. And that just about put me away because I couldn't imagine...I had experienced a period where Hamp had come in town, when Wes was with him, and I'm saying they had those two bass players. That's when I had last saw the band, with Charlie Harris on bass and Charlie Mingus. And when they came to town, Wes was working with the band. It gave me an opportunity to meet the players.
